workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free for the meeting next week:

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Please check these times against Elena's and David's calendars. Let me know which slot works for everyone, and I'll create the booking.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. The only time that works for all four partners is Thursday at 14:30. Please go ahead and create the booking for that time. I'll send the confirmation email once you're done.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: All done. The meeting is booked for Thursday at 14:30. Over to you to send the confirmation email, Brad.

emails.body: Dear partners, this email is to confirm the booking of your upcoming meeting. It is scheduled for Thursday, November 19, at 14:30 Eastern time. Please let us know if you have any questions. Best regards, Brad and Alison.
